title: Arya WhatsApp Sales Consultant Fine-Tune Dataset
description: Schema for train.jsonl (200 examples) and valid.jsonl (40 examples) used to fine-tune the Arya sales assistant model.

prompt.description: Full input string: the exact system prompt followed by a blank line and then the user's incoming WhatsApp message. Format: '<SYSTEM_PROMPT>\n\n<USER_MESSAGE>'
prompt.example:
You are Arya, a friendly WhatsApp Sales Consultant...

Hi, who is this?

completion.description: The assistant's ideal reply as Arya — short, WhatsApp-friendly, warm, with light emojis. For negative examples, this intentionally demonstrates bad behavior (long paragraphs, aggression, fabricated claims).
completion.example: Hi! I'm Arya 😊 Reaching out about Coach Yogesh Vats' Jira with AI Masterclass — a LIVE 2-hour session at just ₹99. Curious to know more?

meta.description: Metadata about the training example for filtering, analysis, and curriculum balance.

scenario.description: The conversation scenario type this example belongs to.

name_present.description: Whether the contact's name is present/known in this example. Arya should use it if true.

role_relevant.description: Whether the contact's role is relevant to the Jira + AI Masterclass (i.e., they work in tech, PM, or Agile).

tone.description: The intended tone of the assistant's completion.

label.description: Whether this is a positive (ideal) example or a negative (bad behavior) example. Negative examples teach the model what NOT to do.
